d: one who cards, cleans, and/or bleaches cloth
to stitch or sew pieces of cloth together
to make yarn by twisting fibers together as one of the steps in making cloth
pertaining to an unshrunken condition of cloth, that is, before it has been washed and dried
(derivative of {L:ὑφαίνω<SDBG:ὑφαίνω:000000>} ‘to weave,’ {D:48.3}) pertaining to being woven
(derivative of ῥάπτω ‘to sew together,’ not occurring in the NT) pertaining to being without a seam, that is, without being sewn together
